item.title: Tyrone road closed following crash

item.title: Johnny Barton BEM, survivor of IRA attacks and respected Fermanagh farmer, dies
item.description: The death has occurred of William John “Johnny” Barton BEM (MiD), a Fermanagh farmer who survived two IRA assassination attempts during the Troubles and later spoke publicly about the impact the violence had on his life and family.

item.title: LIVE: SOAS host rally for return of emergency surgery at SWAH
item.description: The community in Fermanagh is set to make its voice heard this Sunday as campaigners call for the return of emergency surgery to the South West Acute Hospital (SWAH). The hospital campaign group Save Our Acute Services (SOAS) is organising a public rally and Truck and Tractor run at the Diamond in Enniskillen at 3pm today (February 8).
